answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by weighting each account's emission on the convex carry of its bond: (minimum-stake times closes-held) squared, scored at the nadir of its balance, not a settlement peak. One identity freezing 500 POA for forty closes earns the full term; a farm of 1000 clones must each lock a separate 500 POA through the same tide of closes, since capital shifted between aliases drops every clone's nadir to zero and forfeits its carry. The crystal ledger stores each per-close balance, so settlement reads the minimum directly and slashes thin tenure with no jury.
